fullDesc: On June 28, 1914 Gavrilo Princip shot Archduke Franz Ferdinand, heir to the Austro-Hungarian throne, in Sarajevo. Within weeks, alliances pulled Europe's great powers into World War I.
realFacts: Princip was a Bosnian Serb nationalist
The archduke's driver had taken a wrong turn
Austria-Hungary declared war on Serbia on July 28
The war killed about 20 million people
